subject: Server connection issue of the NBLAST on-the-fly website

messages.author: 130ec4a090f946e4
messages.subject: Server connection issue of the NBLAST on-the-fly website
parts:
Dear all,

My student and I have encountered a server connection issue of the NBLAST on-the-fly website for consistently 5 days now. The website (http://nblast.virtualflybrain.org:8080/NBLAST_on-the-fly/) showed 'disconnected from the server'. 

It would be great if you could let us know what the issue might be and how to solve it, since NBLAST has been very useful for our research. Thank you!

Best regards,
Ivy

messages.author: e5958e7785943528
messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] Server connection issue of the NBLAST on-the-fly website
parts:
Hi both,

The problem seems to be down to a restart in quick succession causing issues with the cached results downloading:
<simpleError in download.file.wcheck(url, destdir = folderpath, ...): Unable to read url: http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/flycircuit/allbyallblastcanon_f9dc90ce5b2ffb74af37db1e3a2cb35b.desc and no cached file exists!>

I've restarted the server and am hopeful it should resolve the issue; though it will take approx 50 mins to redownload all the data before normal service resumes.

Thanks,

Rob
